How the Service Works

From database
to booked meeting

A managed pipeline, run for you end to end, that ends in meetings with the people who can sign off a commercial solar project.

Step 01

Find

CEG Ai Prospector searches a database of over 79M commercial property contacts to find prospects that fit your ideal customer profile, and builds a high quality pipeline around them.

Step 02

Engage

Smarter email outreach campaigns speak directly to decision makers, with automated follow ups keeping the conversation moving, plus LinkedIn strategy working alongside.

Step 03

Meet

You receive 100% vetted and exclusive appointments, booked with decision makers and ready for your sales team to walk into.

Step 04

Grow

Your pipeline flows into your favourite CRM, and every project is backed by a Success Manager, a Project Manager, and one or more Sales Development Representatives.

Services

Everything behind
the meetings

Four services working as one system, built for commercial solar businesses that sell to other businesses.

Service 01

CEG Ai Prospector

AI lead generation using the database of over 79M commercial property contacts. It finds the prospects that fit your ideal customer profile and builds high quality pipelines for your sales team.

Service 02

Smarter Email Outreach Campaign & Automation

Email drip campaigns tailored to decision makers, with automated follow ups, plus LinkedIn strategy to reach the full buyer committee.

Service 03

CRM Integration

We integrate the CEG Ai leads pipeline with your favourite CRM, so every appointment and opportunity lands where your team already works.

Service 04

Guaranteed Exclusive & Ready

Pre qualified, sales ready opportunities that are exclusively yours. Each project gets a Success Manager, a Project Manager, and one or more Sales Development Representatives.
